feature: E06 confirmed pantry and freezer batches
scope: 321 native application tests and one Free UI journey. The UI recorded an actual batch for a meal need, corrected its usable amount, relaunched and read its reservations and shortage. Focused models include unscheduled pantry entry, explicit matching, reserving a draft list ingredient, protected lunch allocation, stale correction, retry and reconfirming a prior batch.
limitations: Local simulator and on-device SQLite. No external account, signed device or human language review in this run.
